message.content: In one of the conversations, Wolfgang Schulz suggested that they should stick to practicing on Sundays rather than during the weekdays. He explained that he was too busy with his work during the week and that Sundays were ideal for their jam sessions. Additionally, Wolfgang suggested exploring the use of electronic vibes in their music, suggesting that they could blend their acoustic styles with some synth sounds. He also proposed the idea of playing original songs, which was discussed further during a subsequent conversation where they brainstormed potential themes and song ideas. Overall, Wolfgang was enthusiastic about incorporating these new elements into their music practice sessions.
